_comment: Sample blog post. Edit or delete this file and its entry in data/blog.json when you write your own. Copy data/blog/_template.json to start a new one.
title: Welcome to my blog
lead: A place for longer notes on projects, tools, and whatever I am figuring out.
body: This is a sample post, here so you can see how the blog works. Everything on this page comes from data/blog/welcome.json — edit it, or copy data/blog/_template.json to make a new one.

1. Copy data/blog/_template.json to data/blog/your-slug.json (for example wind-tunnel-notes.json).
  2. Fill in title, date, an optional lead, and the body (a list of HTML blocks, one per line).
  3. Add an entry to data/blog.json with the same slug.
That is it — the post shows up in the list on the Blog page and gets its own page at post.html?slug=your-slug.
